problem_statement: The mDNS stack has no way to continuously query for an arbitrary record type and receive the raw record bytes as results are discovered or expire. A caller needs to start a record querier for a name (first label plus optional remaining labels) and a record type, get results reported through a callback carrying the record's raw data, length, type, name and a TTL (zero meaning the record was removed), stop the querier later, and iterate over the active record queriers with their cache state. The querier must reject record types that have dedicated browsers/resolvers (PTR, SRV, TXT, A, AAAA), report cached results immediately when a second querier for the same name and type is started, and emit the query and refresh queries over the standard mDNS schedule.
